mapper.insert: insert into inspection_plan ( name, inspector_id, frequency_type, execution_time, start_date, end_date, deadline_hours, enabled, next_generate_at, remark ) values ( #{name}, #{inspectorId}, #{frequencyType}, #{executionTime}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{deadlineHours}, #{enabled}, #{nextGenerateAt}, #{remark} )

insert into inspection_plan_item ( plan_id, inspection_item_id, sort_no ) values
( #{planId}, #{itemId}, #{index} + 1 )
mapper.select:
select plan_id, day_value from inspection_plan_schedule where plan_id in
#{planId}

select p.id, p.name, p.inspector_id, u.display_name as inspector_name, p.frequency_type, p.execution_time, p.enabled, p.next_generate_at,
count(distinct pe.equipment_id) as equipment_count,
count(distinct pi.inspection_item_id) as inspection_item_count
from inspection_plan p
left join sys_user u on u.id = p.inspector_id
left join inspection_plan_equipment pe on pe.plan_id = p.id
left join inspection_plan_item pi on pi.plan_id = p.id
and p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and p.inspector_id = #{inspectorId}
and p.frequency_type = #{frequencyType}
and p.enabled = #{enabled}
group by p.id, p.name, p.inspector_id, u.display_name, p.frequency_type, p.execution_time, p.enabled, p.next_generate_at
order by p.created_at desc
select * from inspection_plan where id = #{inspectionPlanId} for update

select p.id, p.name, p.inspector_id, u.display_name as inspector_name, p.frequency_type, p.execution_time, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.deadline_hours, (select count(*) from inspection_plan_equipment pe where pe.plan_id = p.id) as equipment_count, (select count(*) from inspection_plan_item pi where pi.plan_id = p.id) as inspection_item_count, p.enabled, p.next_generate_at, p.remark, p.created_at, p.updated_at from inspection_plan p inner join sys_user u on u.id = p.inspector_id where p.id = #{inspectionPlanId}

select e.id, e.code, e.name, e.equipment_type_id, e.area_id from inspection_plan_equipment pe inner join equipment e on e.id = pe.equipment_id where pe.plan_id = #{inspectionPlanId} order by e.name, e.id

select ii.id, ii.code, ii.name, ii.result_type, ii.unit, ii.is_required as required from inspection_plan_item pi inner join inspection_item ii on ii.id = pi.inspection_item_id where pi.plan_id = #{inspectionPlanId} order by pi.sort_no, ii.id
select equipment_id from inspection_plan_equipment where plan_id = #{inspectionPlanId} order by equipment_id
select inspection_item_id from inspection_plan_item where plan_id = #{inspectionPlanId} order by sort_no, inspection_item_id
select day_value from inspection_plan_schedule where plan_id = #{inspectionPlanId} order by day_value
mapper.update: update inspection_plan set name = #{name}, inspector_id = #{inspectorId}, frequency_type = #{frequencyType}, execution_time = #{executionTime}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, deadline_hours = #{deadlineHours}, next_generate_at = #{nextGenerateAt}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id from inspection_plan where enabled = 1 and next_generate_at is not null and next_generate_at <= #{now} order by next_generate_at, id limit #{limit}
